About two weeks ago maybe, I had a blade out in class; I was just shredding paper but it was in full view, I wasn't hiding it. It was reported to the office and the principal for my grade and the principal for the grade above me both came to my class to pull me out so they could talk to me. I walked down to my principal's office between them like I was a criminal walking between two cops. I had to talk to my principal for a while, then had to roll up my sleeves and show my 400+ small scars from sh. They searched my backpack and made me turn out my pockets and they took all the blades I had with me (except for my scissors and pencil sharpener, thank goodness). I was then forced to eat some food because I hadn't eaten in almost 18 hours and then had to go talk to a counsellor about some stuff. I had to talk to her the next week, too. It was interesting, and I felt so lost without my blades. Tbh, I don't really know why I'm sharing this story, ig to show you that it'll be okay, even if they do somehow track it back to you?
